info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Party Reference Data Directory Validation-spec
info.description: This API enables the validation of party reference data within the banking customer management system. It allows for the submission of updates to existing validation rules that govern the integrity and accuracy of party data. Key users of this API include data governance teams and developers responsible for maintaining data quality standards in their applications. By ensuring that party reference data adheres to predefined validation criteria, organizations can enhance decision-making and compliance efforts. This contributes to more efficient and reliable customer management outcomes.

put.summary: Update validation status for a specific party.
put.description: This endpoint allows developers to update the validation status associated with a specified party in the party reference data directory. Providing the correct party ID is crucial for ensuring the changes are applied correctly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to validate party reference data for the specified party ID. It includes all necessary information required to perform the validation, ensuring that data integrity and consistency are maintained. Make sure to provide the appropriate structure as defined in the schema.

200.description: Request was successful, and the validation data has been updated.
